resolved_conflicts.explanation: The list's original note says the tower cannot be found in older aerial imagery; its later update says it is visible on Google Street View. Both are imagery-based. Status is kept as standing per the list and is unverified on the ground.

notes_for_editor: Thin evidence. Wikipedia's list is the only source with substance on this tower, and it gives no construction date, height, owner, staffing or use. TopoQuest is a gazetteer entry: it gives the point elevation (167 ft MSL) and map name, and it calls St. Helena Parish a county, which is a terminology slip, not a correction to the record. Search results also surfaced a 213 m cable-stayed mast and an 89 m CAPLINE tower at Pine Grove; both are communications structures, not lookouts, and are not used. The local NHLR crawl has no page for this tower (nhlr.org/lookouts/us/la/pine-grove-lookout-tower/ returns 404). Records most likely at the LDAF Office of Forestry or the Louisiana chapter of FFLA; a photo or a dated record would be the main gain.
